onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to ShookShok
onboarding.welcome.sub: Lives quietly until you press a shortcut
onboarding.welcome.sub~mac: Lives in your menu bar until you press a shortcut
onboarding.welcome.sub~win: Lives in your taskbar until you press a shortcut
onboarding.welcome.captureDesc: Snap regions, windows, or screens and mark them up
onboarding.welcome.drawDesc: Sketch right over your screen or on a whiteboard
onboarding.welcome.zoomDesc: Magnify live motion smoothly while presenting
onboarding.permScreen.title: Allow Screen Recording
onboarding.permScreen.sub: macOS requires Screen Recording permission to capture your screen
onboarding.permScreen.step1: Click [Open settings] below to jump to permission settings
onboarding.permScreen.step1~mac: Click [Open settings] below to jump to System Settings
onboarding.permScreen.step2: Turn on the switch next to ShookShok
onboarding.permScreen.step3: If it still shows off, click [Relaunch to verify]
onboarding.permScreen.relaunchHint: Screen Recording often takes a quick relaunch to apply
onboarding.permAx.title: Allow Accessibility
onboarding.permAx.sub: Needed to detect window bounds and listen for global shortcuts
onboarding.permAx.step1: Click [Open settings] below to jump to permission settings
onboarding.permAx.step1~mac: Click [Open settings] below to jump to System Settings
onboarding.permAx.step3: We check automatically and update as soon as it’s on
onboarding.skip.link: I’ll do this later (some features won’t work)
onboarding.skip.title: Skip permissions for now?
onboarding.skip.desc: Screen capture and window detection won’t work without these permissions. You can turn them on anytime in Settings › General.
onboarding.conflicts.title: Shortcut check
onboarding.conflicts.sub: Checking whether other apps already claim your shortcuts
onboarding.conflicts.okDesc: All default shortcuts are ready to use
onboarding.conflicts.fkeyInfo: While active, F1–F3 override Help, Rename, and Find in other apps
onboarding.autostart.title: Start at sign-in
onboarding.autostart.sub: Keep ShookShok ready in the background when you sign in
onboarding.autostart.sub~mac: Keep ShookShok ready in your menu bar when you turn on your Mac
onboarding.autostart.sub~win: Keep ShookShok ready in your taskbar when you turn on your PC
onboarding.autostart.rowSub~mac: Starts quietly in the menu bar
onboarding.autostart.hint: You can change this anytime in Settings › General
onboarding.keys.title: Three keys to know
onboarding.keys.sub: Remember just these three shortcuts to get started
onboarding.keys.fkeyNote: F keys may require holding fn depending on keyboard settings
onboarding.keys.fkeyNote~mac: Press F keys with fn · Or enable standard function keys in System Settings
onboarding.keys.fkeyNote~win: You can customize any key anytime under Change shortcuts
onboarding.keys.cheatHint: Press ? inside any mode for a quick shortcut cheat sheet
onboarding.ready.title: You’re all set
onboarding.ready.sub: Try your first capture right away with the practice card below
onboarding.ready.skippedWarn: Some permissions are still off. You can enable them anytime in Settings › General.
onboarding.ready.skippedWarn~mac: Some permissions are still off. Enable them anytime in Settings › General › Permission check.
onboarding.ready.skippedWarn~win: Some items still need attention. Review them anytime in Settings › General.
onboarding.ready.practiceDesc: Press {key} or click [Try it now] below to capture
onboarding.ready.practiceDescNoKey: Click [Try it now] below to capture
onboarding.ready.practicePromptNoKey: Use the button below to capture this card
onboarding.ready.practiceDoneDesc: You can capture anytime with that same shortcut
onboarding.howto.title: How to turn off {app} shortcuts
onboarding.howto.sub: Disable the shortcut in the other app or pick a new key in ShookShok
onboarding.howto.snipaste1: Open Snipaste from your status area
onboarding.howto.snipaste1~mac: Click the Snipaste icon on the right side of the menu bar
onboarding.howto.snipaste1~win: Right-click the Snipaste icon in the taskbar notification area
onboarding.howto.snipaste2: Open Preferences › Hotkeys and clear or change keys like F1 and F3
onboarding.howto.snipaste3: Or quit Snipaste if you plan to use ShookShok instead
onboarding.howto.powertoys2: Select Always on Top or the conflicting utility
onboarding.howto.powertoys3: Disable its activation shortcut or assign a different key
onboarding.howto.generic2: Disable or reassign the conflicting shortcut in its keyboard settings
onboarding.howto.generic3: Or click [Open shortcuts] below to pick a different key in ShookShok
